h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhusawal

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhusawal

items.pText: Bhusawal in Jalgaon district is one of the main railway junctions of central India, and its railway colonies, schools and the thermal power station township shape much of the town. FunPlay Systems is about 350 km away at Vasai, in the same state, and we supply outdoor playground equipment to Bhusawal by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Maharashtra sets it up on site.

Khandesh is among the hottest parts of Maharashtra. From April to early June the afternoon sun makes any exposed slide or deck uncomfortable, and children simply stop using a playground that has no shade. So we start every Bhusawal layout with one question: where does the shade fall at four in the afternoon? Send us photos taken at that hour, and we will place the equipment to make the most of trees and buildings.

richText.heading: Making a playground usable in Khandesh summers

beside the play area gives a shaded resting spot.

items.q: Which way should a playground slide face in a hot town?
items.a: Away from the afternoon sun, ideally towards the north or east. The sliding surface then stays cooler in the late afternoon, when most children come out to play.

items.q: Can you add shade to a playground?
items.a: Yes. Our garden decor range includes pergolas and gazebos that can stand beside the play area. Existing trees on the west side also help a great deal.

items.q: How far is Bhusawal from your factory?
items.a: About 350 km by road from our factory in Vasai East. We deliver and install with our own team or a dealer in Maharashtra.
